dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently aimed at comparing a user's site with competitors to produce keyword, topic, format, funnel, and calendar recommendations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger examples include broad phrases like "what content am I missing," but the instructions explicitly scope the work to competitor-relative analysis and tell the agent to ask for competitors or switch workflows when needed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown skill and reference files only, with no bundled executable scripts, install hooks, or hidden runtime components; duplicate " 2" files appear identical and redundant rather than behavior-changing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Optional SEO, analytics, trend, RSS, Reddit/Hacker News, and Firecrawl-style scraping inputs are disclosed and proportionate for content-gap research, but users should understand they may involve external services if enabled by the host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly writes durable summaries, keyword priorities, competitor facts, and open loops to memory paths; this persistence is disclosed and aligned with research handoff, with no background worker or privilege escalation shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad activation wording could cause occasional misrouting, but the artifact-backed workflow requires competitor-relative analysis, includes stop-and-ask gates, and discloses memory writes, so this is guidance-level rather than Review-level concern.
[VirusTotal-clean] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
llm.guidance: Install this if you want competitor-relative SEO and editorial planning. Provide your site and competitor domains, and review the saved memory notes if the request involves private strategy, analytics, or search-console data; avoid using it for generic ideation where a keyword-research or content-planning workflow would be a better fit.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed SEO content-gap workflow whose memory writes and optional competitor-research connectors fit its stated purpose.
